global_experience.layout: Content sits in a centred column up to 1200px wide. The top bar is fixed and translucent. Sections alternate white and a very light grey.
global_experience.look: Design restaurant_001 ('Marina clean card'): clean, friendly, bright, one accent colour from the brief, 8, 12 and 16px corners, soft card shadows. The reference components in reference/ are used as written.
global_experience.header: The restaurant name at the left in the accent colour, links to the sections that exist, and one accent button (Reserve a table, Request a table, or Call to reserve). On phones the links hide and the name shortens with an ellipsis; the button stays.
global_experience.feedback: The only form is the table request form, shown only when the builder gave the site an address to send it to; every other button opens a real link or a phone call. A slim bar slides in under the top of the page once the hero has scrolled away.
global_experience.empty_states: A section with nothing real to show is not drawn. A missing picture is never a broken image or a grey box: hero and gallery use a colour field made from the accent, a dish card simply has no picture strip.

pages.purpose: Show what the place is, what it serves, when it is open and how to reach it, within five seconds on a phone.
pages.sections: In order: hero, menu highlights, full menu, about, gallery, reviews, catering, ways to enjoy us, footer. Only the sections that have real content are drawn.

states.loading: Rendered at build time, so there is no loading state.
states.reserve: Opens the owner's booking link in a new tab, or starts a phone call when only a phone exists. With neither, the button is not drawn. With a request address and no booking link it is the table request form: a request the restaurant confirms, never a booking.
states.menu_chips: Category chips scroll sideways on narrow screens and jump to the category.

pages.purpose: Tell the visitor the page does not exist and offer a way home.
pages.sections: A short message and a link to the home page.
